title: Find the Count of Good Integers
summary: Count n-digit integers that can be rearranged, without a leading zero, into a palindrome divisible by k. Secondary source; the official LeetCode page was not reached.
examples: n = 3, k = 5 -> 27 and n = 1, k = 4 -> 2 (Jointaro listing, not official).
visualizationNotes: Playback accepts n up to 6 and k up to 9. Enumerates palindromes and counts arrangements per digit multiset; checked by permutation brute force for n up to 4.
